resources.string: Learns where you really swipe over each key, so your swipes are read more accurately over time
Learns where your swipes start, end and turn for each key, and adjusts new swipes to match before they are read.
How quickly it trusts what it learned, and how far it adjusts your swipes. Stronger adapts sooner and more.

It learns from swipes you keep, and from swipes you fix (delete and swipe again, pick another suggestion, or go back and change the word). A fix only counts when your swipe really went over every letter of the new word, so a botched swipe is never learned. Only per-key positions are saved, never words or swipe paths, and never from password or incognito fields.
Adaptive swipe learning is off. What it learned is kept, but not used or updated.
Swipe profiles show up in the typing heatmap, marked \"swipe\"
This deletes everything Pluto has learned about how you swipe. What it learned from your taps is kept. It can\'t be undone.
